evidence.source: Antiquities and Monuments Office, Hong Kong
evidence.field: Silk manuscript of Yinyang Wuxing, Article B: period and provenance
evidence.text: The museum record identifies this silk manuscript as Western Han and says it was unearthed in 1973 at Mawangdui Tomb M3. This independently supports dating the Tomb 3 manuscript context to the Western Han; it does not identify the particular 笑 manuscript passage or verify its written graph.
evidence.title: Silk manuscript of Yinyang Wuxing (Yinyang and the Five Elements) Article B

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫（Chinese University of Hong Kong）
evidence.text: The entry reports 笑 in the Mawangdui Laozi B, preceding lost text, section 稱, line 152, quoting 「至樂不笑」. Together with the museum’s Western Han identification of Tomb 3 manuscripts, this supports describing it as a reported Mawangdui manuscript use in a Western Han manuscript context. The graph itself and its artifact have not been inspected here.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫: 笑

search_audit.query: Mawangdui manuscripts tomb 3 sealed 168 BCE dating official museum Han dynasty manuscript
search_audit.outcome: Search found museum and archival records for Mawangdui context. Opened the Antiquities and Monuments Office record, which identifies a Mawangdui Tomb M3 manuscript as Western Han and reports its 1973 excavation. Hunan Museum exhibition page timed out on open.

search_audit.query: Opened museum Tomb 3 manuscript record, CUHK 笑 entry
search_audit.outcome: The museum record supports Western Han dating for the Tomb 3 manuscript context. CUHK reports the 笑 quotation at line 152 of the Mawangdui Laozi B preceding text, but no manuscript image or graph was inspected.

gaps: The external museum record dates a Tomb 3 manuscript to the Western Han, but does not itself identify the exact Laozi B preceding-text passage cited by CUHK. The Western Han label therefore applies to the reported manuscript context, not to a directly inspected 笑 artifact or graph.
The exact physical graph, locus, and earliest physical attestation remain unverified.
